original: citraṃnisiṃraśadhūmaste pratīpāgnyanumāpaka" iti kāvyaśloke naiyāyikakalpatirūḍherapyupayogadarśanāt| nanu "puruśānna paraṃ kiṃci"dityatra puruṣaḥ paṃcaviṃśa iti kathamavagamyate, yenāyaṃ paṃcaviṃśātiriktaniṣedhassyāditi cet, itthaṃ|

original: yadyapi sāṃkhyānāmmahattatva eva buddhiśabdaḥ, ātmaśabdaśca cetane, tathāpi pratyabhijñāpakabhūyastvānusāreṇa kārye kāraṇopacārādahaṅkāre buddhiśabdaḥ, mahattatve vyāpakatvayogenātmaśabdaḥ| "yacchedvāṅmanasī prājñastadyacchejjñāna ātmanī" tyuparitanamantre jñānepyātmaśabdadarśanāt| nanu pūrvatra "ātmānaṃ rathinaṃ viddhi śarīraṃ rathameva tu|

original: pūrvatra rathirathādirūpeṇa rūpitānāṃ madhye yaccharīraṃ ratharūpakeṇa vinyastaṃ tadātmanārūpitaṃ tadavyaktaśabdena pariśeṣāt gṛhyata iti yuktam| tatrahyātmā śarīraṃ buddhirmana indriyāṇitadviṣayā iti ṣaḍarthā ratharathisārathitadgṛhyamāṇaturagarajjuturagatanmārgātmanā yadrūpitāḥ tanmuktayarthopāsanopakaraṇatvādvaśīkāryatvāyeti tāvannirvivādaṃ|

original: "yastvavijñānavānbhavati ayuktena manasā saha| tasyendriyāṇyavaśyāni duṣṭāśvā iva sāratheḥ| yastu vijñānavānbhavati yuktena manasā saha| tasyeṃndriyāṇi vaśyāni sadaśvā iva sārathe"riti tatraiva śravaṇāt| tatra ca vaśīkāryatāyāṃ prādhānyāprādhānyavivecanamapekṣitaṃ yat pradhānaṃ tadvaśīkaraṇe yatnātiśayasiddhye|

original: puruṣannirguṇaṃ prāpya kālasaṃkhyā na vidyata" iti sāṃkhyakalpitatattadupāsanāphalabhūyastvālpatvarūpaḥ parāparabhāva iti vaktuṃ śakyam| tatra manasaḥ indriyebhyaḥ pṛthakparigaṇanābhāvena bhūtatanmātrāpekṣayā nikarṣāpattyā tadviṣayatve "arthebhyaścaparammana" iti manaindriyasya arthaśabdoktabhūtaparatvoktyanupapatteḥ|

original: nāpi hetuhetumadbhāvarūpa iti vaktuṃ śakyam| sāṃkhyamate indriyāṇāmāhaṅkārikatvena " indriyebhyaḥ parāhyarthā" iti bhūtatanmātrāṇāmiṃdriyaparatvoktyanupapatteḥ, teṣāṃ bhautikatvābhyupagame "arthebhyaśca paraṃ mana " iti manaṃiṃdriyasya bhūtaparatvoktayanupapatteḥ| tasmāt iṃdriyebhyaḥ tadviṣayāḥ vaśīkāryatve parāḥ|

original: vaśyeṃdriyasyāpi viṣayasannidhāviṃdriyavijṛmbhaṇāt| tebhyo'pi manaḥ paraṃ| manasi viṣayadhyānapravṛtte viṣayāsannidhāne rāgavijṛmbhaṇāt| tasmādapi buddhiḥ parā| adhyavasāyābhāve manaso'kiṃcitkaratvāt| tato'pyātmā paraḥ| sarvasyā api viṣayavṛtteḥ ātmecchāyattatvāt| tata evātmā aṇurapi mahāniti viśeṣyate| tasmādapi śarīraṃ paraṃ|

original: tadidamiṃdriyādiparamapuruṣāntānāṃ vaśīkāryatāyāmuttarottaraparatvamagre śrutireva darśayati - "yacchedvāṅmanasī prājñastadyacchejjñāna ātmani| jñānamātmani mahati niyacchettadyacchecchāntaātmanī"ti| asya hi mantrasyāyamarthaḥ| vāgupalakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ jñānakarmendriyajātaṃ manasi niyacchet| bāhyendriyavyāpāramutsṛjya manomātreṇāvatiṣṭhet|

original: tasmātsūkṣmavyākṛtamavyaktaśabdārhamiti tadavasthāṃtararūpaṃ śarūramupacārādavyaktamityuktam| yadi sūkṣmamavyākṛtamabhyupagamyate tarhi tadeva sāṃkhyamatamāpannamiti kathaṃ tannirasanam| svatantramevāvyākṛtaṃ kāryāṇi sādhayatīti sāṃkhyamatannirasanīyam|

original: kevalatarkamavaṣṭabhyāpāditāni dūṣaṇānīti prathamapādena nirākṛtāni| tatrāpi praṇetṛgauraveṇa teṣāṃ tarkāṇāmupādeyatva śaṅkāsmṛtyadhikaraṇayogādhikaraṇābhyāṃnirākṛtā| tattattarkasvarūpaparyālocanayā teṣāmupādeyatvaśaṅkā navilakṣaṇatvādhikaraṇamārambha nirākṛtā|
analyzed: kevala tarkam avaṣṭabhya āpāditāni dūṣaṇāni iti prathama pādena nirākṛtāni tatra api praṇetṛ gauraveṇa teṣām tarkāṇām upādeya tva śaṅkā smṛti adhikaraṇa yoga adhikaraṇābhyām nirākṛtā tad tad tarka svarūpa paryālocanayā teṣām upādeya tva śaṅkā na vilakṣaṇa tva adhikaraṇam ārambha nirākṛtā

original: evamādyādhikaraṇayostṛtīyādīnāmaṣṭānāmadhikaraṇānāñcāvāntarārthabhede'pi brahmavādapratikṣepakatarkanirākaraṇārthatvenaikārthyaṃ, asminpāde śuṣkatarkālambanāssāṃkhyādipakṣāstathābhūtaireva tarkairdūṣyante|
analyzed: evam ādya adhikaraṇayoḥ tṛtīya ādīnām aṣṭānām adhikaraṇānām ca avāntarārtha bhede pi brahma vāda pratikṣepaka tarka nirākaraṇa artha tvena aikārthyam asmin pāde śuṣka tarka ālambanāḥ sāṃkhya ādi pakṣāḥ tathābhūtaiḥ eva tarkaiḥ dūṣyante

original: anyathā pradhānādikāraṇatvapratiṣṭhāpakānāṃ parapakṣāṇāṃ tadarkābhāsamūlatvaṃ jānatāṃ mandadhiyāṃ teṣu prāmāṇikatvaśaṅkayā brahmavādaśraddhā śithilībhavet| evaṃ svapakṣasthāpanārthaḥ prathamapādaḥ| parapakṣapratikṣepārtho'yaṃ pādaḥ| svapakṣasthāpanasyābhyarhitatvāt prathamaṃ kṛtamiti tadānantaryamasya|
analyzed: anyathā pradhāna ādi kāraṇatva pratiṣṭhāpakānām para pakṣāṇām tad arka ābhāsa mūla tvam jānatām manda dhiyām teṣu prāmāṇika tva śaṅkayā brahmavāda śraddhā śithilībhavet evam sva pakṣa sthāpana arthaḥ prathama pādaḥ para pakṣa pratikṣepa arthaḥ ayam pādaḥ sva pakṣa sthāpanasya abhyarhita tvāt prathamam kṛtam iti tad ānantaryam asya

original: yadyapi tṛtīyacaturthapādayorapi kāryagocaraśrutivirodhaparihāreṇa svapakṣasthāpanaṃ kriyate, tathā'pi kāraṇaviṣayatvena prathamadvitīyapādayoraikārthyena avāntarasaṅgatiḥ| tatra vaidikānumatasatkāryavādādyabhyupagamena sāṃkhyamatasyopādeyatvasambhāvanāspadatvātirekāt prathamaṃ tannirākaraṇaṃ kriyate|
analyzed: yadi api tṛtīya caturtha pādayoḥ api kārya gocara śruti virodha parihāreṇa sva pakṣa sthāpanam kriyate tathā api kāraṇa viṣaya tvena prathama dvitīya pādayoḥ aikārthyena avāntara saṅgatiḥ tatra vaidika anumata satkārya vāda ādi abhyupagamena sāṃkhya matasya upādeya tva sambhāvanā āspada tva atirekāt prathamam tad nirākaraṇam kriyate

original: sāṃkhyāḥ svatantratarkaiḥ svamataṃ prasādhya svamatānuguṇyena śrutivākyānāṃ nayanaṃ kurvanti| taiḥ kṛtanayanamīkṣatyādyādhikaraṇeṣu nirākṛtam| idānīṃ tadīyāssvatantratarkā nirākriyanta iti na paunaruktyam|
analyzed: sāṃkhyāḥ svatantra tarkaiḥ sva matam prasādhya sva mata ānuguṇyena śruti vākyānām nayanam kurvanti taiḥ kṛta nayanam īkṣati ādya adhikaraṇeṣu nirākṛtam idānīm tadīyāḥ svatantra tarkāḥ nirākriyante iti na paunaruktyam

original: eṣā sāṃkhyānāṃ prakriyā "mūlaprakṛtiravikṛtirmahadādyāḥ prakṛtivikṛtayassapta| ṣoḍaśakaśca vikāro na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ"| tatra mūlaprakṛtiḥ satvarajastamoguṇarūpāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ sāmyāvasthā| sācaikā svayamacetanā sakalacetanabhogāpavargārthā nityā sarvagatā ca svayaṃ prakṛtireva na kasyacidvikṛtiḥ|
analyzed: eṣā sāṃkhyānām prakriyā mūlaprakṛtiḥ avikṛtiḥ mahat ādyāḥ prakṛti vikṛtayaḥ sapta ṣoḍaśakaḥ ca vikāraḥ na prakṛtiḥ na vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ tatra mūlaprakṛtiḥ satva rajaḥ tamaḥ guṇa rūpāṇām dravyāṇām sāmya avasthā sā ca ekā svayam acetanā sakala cetana bhoga apavarga arthā nityā sarva gatā ca svayam prakṛtiḥ eva na kasyacid vikṛtiḥ

original: mahadādyāḥ prakṛtermahān mahato'haṅkāraḥ ahaṅkārāt pañca tanmātrāṇi śabdasparśarūparasagandhātmakānītyetāssapta svasvakāryāpekṣayā prakṛtayaḥ svasvakāraṇāpekṣayā vikṛtayaśca|
analyzed: mahat ādyāḥ prakṛteḥ mahān mahataḥ haṅkāraḥ ahaṅkārāt pañca tanmātrāṇi śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha ātmakāni iti etāḥ sapta sva sva kārya apekṣayā prakṛtayaḥ sva sva kāraṇa apekṣayā vikṛtayaḥ ca

original: ākāśādīni pañca mahābhūtāni śrotrādīni pañca jñānendriyāṇi vāgādīni pañca karmendriyāṇīti ṣoḍaśako guṇo vikṛtireva nakasyacittatvāntarasya prakṛtiḥ puruṣastvapariṇāmitvānnakasyacitprakṛtiḥ| nityatvānnakasyacidvikṛtiḥ| nirdharmakaścaitanyamātravapuḥ sarvagataḥ pratiśarīraṃ bhinnaśca| nirvikāratvānnakartā, nāpi bhoktā|
analyzed: ākāśa ādīni pañca mahābhūtāni śrotra ādīni pañca jñāna indriyāṇi vāc ādīni pañca karmendriyāṇi iti ṣoḍaśakaḥ guṇaḥ vikṛtiḥ eva prakṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ tu apariṇāmi tvāt na kasyacid prakṛtiḥ nitya tvāt na kasyacid vikṛtiḥ nirdharmakaḥ caitanya mātra vapuḥ sarva gataḥ pratiśarīram bhinnaḥ ca nirvikāra tvāt na kartā na api bhoktā

original: evaṃbhūte'pi tatve mūḍhāḥ prakṛtipuruṣasannidhimātreṇa puruṣasya caitanyaṃ prakṛtāvadhyasyanti| tena caitanyayogāt kartṛśaktimattvācca jñātṛtvam| prakṛterevāntaḥ karaṇarūpāpannāyāḥ tasyāśca kartṛtvaṃ puruṣe'dhyasyanti| evamanyonyādhyāsādahaṃkartā ahaṃbhoktetyabhimānātmakobhogastatvajñānādapavargaityevaṃ pañcaviṃśatistatvānīti|
analyzed: evaṃbhūte api tattve mūḍhāḥ prakṛti puruṣa sannidhi mātreṇa puruṣasya caitanyam prakṛtau adhyasyanti tena caitanya yogāt kartṛ śaktimat tvāt ca jñātṛ tvam prakṛteḥ eva antar karaṇa rūpa āpannāyāḥ tasyāḥ ca kartṛ tvam puruṣa idhi asyanti evam anyonya adhyāsāt ahaṃkartā ahaṃbhoktā iti abhimāna ātmakaḥ bhogaḥ tattva jñānāt apavargaḥ iti evam pañcaviṃśatiḥ tattvāni iti

original: tatra sakalamūlakāraṇatvābhimatatvajñānādapavargaityevaṃ pañcaviṃśatistatvānīti| tatra sakalamūlakāraṇatvābhimatasvatantrapradhānānumānanirasanena tanmataṃ sarvaṃ nirastaṃ bhavatīti tadiha nirasyate| idamiha teṣāmanumānaṃ - sarvaṃ kāryaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakadravyaprakṛtikaṃ, tatsamanvitatvāt| sāmānyavyāptau ghaṭādivaditi|
analyzed: tatra sakala mūla kāraṇatva abhimata tva jñānāt apavargaḥ eti evam pañcaviṃśatiḥ tatvāni iti tatra sakala mūla kāraṇatva abhimata svatantra pradhāna anumāna nirasanena tad matam sarvam nirastam bhavati iti tat iha nirasyate idam iha teṣām anumānam sarvam kāryam sukha duḥkha moha ātmaka dravya prakṛtikam tad samanvita tvāt sāmānya vyāptau ghaṭa ādi vat iti

original: ādyānumāne sukhaduḥkhamohātmakāni dravyāṇi kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇatvena sidhyaṃti satvarajastamāṃsyeva paryavasyaṃti, teṣāntathātvāt| uktaṃtatvasaṃgrahe - "prītyaprītiviṣādātmakāḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthā"iti| ayamarthaḥ - satvarajastamoguṇāḥ prītyaprītiviṣādātmakāḥ kramātsukhaduḥkhamohātmakāḥ kramādeva prakāśapravṛttiniyamaprayojanāśca|
analyzed: ādya anumāne sukha duḥkha moha ātmakāni dravyāṇi kāryāṇām kāraṇa tvena sidhyaṃti satva rajaḥ tamāṃsi eva paryavasyaṃti teṣām tathātvāt uktam tatvasaṃgrahe prīti aprīti viṣāda ātmakāḥ prakāśa pravṛtti niyama arthāḥ iti ayam arthaḥ satva rajaḥ tamaḥ guṇāḥ prīti aprīti viṣāda ātmakāḥ kramāt sukha duḥkha moha ātmakāḥ kramāt eva prakāśa pravṛtti niyama prayojanāḥ ca

original: svacchaṃ satvaṃ prakāśayati, rajoguṇaḥ prakāśakārye satvaṃ pravartayati, laghossatvaguṇasya calanasvabhāvena rajasā sarvatra pravartane prasakte yathākāryaṃ gurustamoguṇo niyacchatīti| nacādyahetorasiddhiḥ| kāryāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānvitatvasya lokasiddhatvāt| tathāhi - ghaṭo yena prāpyate taṃ prati satvaguṇodbhavāt ghaṭassukhātmakobhavati|
analyzed: svaccham satvam prakāśayati rajaḥ guṇaḥ prakāśa kārye satvam pravartayati laghoḥ satva guṇasya calana svabhāvena rajasā sarvatra pravartane prasakte yathā kāryam guruḥ tamaḥ guṇaḥ niyacchati iti na ca ādya hetoḥ asiddhiḥ kāryāṇām sukha duḥkha moha anvita tvasya loka siddha tvāt tathā hi ghaṭaḥ yena prāpyate tam prati satva guṇa udbhavāt ghaṭaḥ sukha ātmakaḥ bhavati

original: yadīyassonyenāpahriyate taṃ prati rajoguṇodbhavāt duḥkhātmakobhavati| yasya tasminnupekṣayā darśanameva nodeti taṃ prati tamoguṇodbhavāt mohātmakobhavati| "muhavaicittya"itidhātuḥ| naca guṇānāṃ puruṣabhedavyavasthayodbhave vinigamanāvirahaḥ| tattatpuruṣabhogarūpaprayojanavaśādudbhavāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: yadi iyaḥ saḥ anyena apahriyate tam prati rajaḥ guṇa udbhavāt duḥkha ātmakaḥ bhavati yasya tasmin upekṣayā darśanam eva na udeti tam prati tamaḥ guṇa udbhavāt moha ātmakaḥ bhavati muha vaicittyā eti dhātuḥ na ca guṇānām puruṣa bheda vyavasthayā udbhave vinigamana avirahaḥ tad tad puruṣa bhoga rūpa prayojana vaśāt udbhava asiddheḥ

original: tadyathā - satvaṃ rajastamasī kañcitprati kadācidabhibhūya śāntāṃ svavṛtiṃta labhate, evaṃ rajassatvatamasī abhibhūya ghorāṃ svavṛtiṃta, tamaḥ satvarajasīābhibhūya mūḍhāṃ svavṛttimiti| naca dvitīyānumānasya paramāṇvādikāraṇakatvenārthāntaraṃ, lāghavādekakāraṇakatvasiddheḥ|
analyzed: tat yathā satvam rajaḥ tamasī kañcid prati kadācid abhibhūya śāntām sva vṛtim ta labhate evam rajaḥ satva tamasī abhibhūya ghorām sva vṛtim ta tamaḥ satva rajasī abhibhūya mūḍhām sva vṛttim iti na ca dvitīya anumānasya paramāṇu ādi kāraṇaka tvena artha antaram lāghavāt eka kāraṇaka tva siddheḥ

original: naca tathāpi brahmaprakṛtikatvenārthāntaraṃ jaḍaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaṃ kāryajātaṃ pratyatathābhūtasya kāraṇatvena sidhyanavakāśāditi| evaṃrūpasya sāṃkhyānumānasya duṣaṇānumānamucyate| pradhānaṃ na jagadracanāyāṃ samartham| acetanatve sati cetanānadhiṣṭhitatvāt| yadevaṃ tadevam| yathā cetanānadhiṣṭhitaṃ mṛddārvādikam|
analyzed: na ca tathā api brahma prakṛtika tvena artha antaram jaḍam sukha duḥkha moha ātmakam kārya jātam prati atathābhūtasya kāraṇa tvena sidhi anavakāśāt iti evaṃrūpasya sāṃkhya anumānasya duṣaṇa anumānam ucyate pradhānam na jagat racanāyām samartham acetana tve sati cetanā anadhiṣṭhita tvāt yat evam tat evam yathā cetanā anadhiṣṭhitam mṛd dārva ādikam

original: na ca vyāptyasiddhiḥ, cetanānadhiṣṭhitasya kāryārambhakatvānupapatteḥ, cetanādhiṣṭhitasyaiva kāryārambhapravṛttessarvatra darśanācca| nanu siddhānte pakṣāsiddhiḥ| naca "pradhānakṣetrajñapatirguṇeśa" iti śrutisiddhaṃ pradhānaṃ siddhānte'pyastīti vācyam| tasyānumānagamyatvābhāvena karmavyutpanna sūtrānumānapadanirdeśyatvāyogāt|
analyzed: na ca vyāpti asiddhiḥ cetanā anadhiṣṭhitasya kārya ārambhaka tva anupapatteḥ cetanā dhiṣṭhitasya eva kārya ārambha pravṛtteḥ sarvatra darśanāt ca nanu siddhānte pakṣa asiddhiḥ na ca pradhāna kṣetrajña patiḥ guṇa īśaḥ iti śruti siddham pradhānam siddhānte pi asti iti vācyam tasya anumāna gamya tva abhāvena karma vyutpanna sūtra anumāna pada nirdeśya tva ayogāt

original: sādhyasya ca bādhaḥ, pradhānasya siddhānte'pi jagadracanāsāmarthyābhyupagamāt| hetoścāsiddhiḥ, tasya siddhānte cetanādhiṣṭhānasattvāditi cet - satyaṃ|
analyzed: sādhyasya ca bādhaḥ pradhānasya siddhānte pi jagat racanā sāmarthya abhyupagamāt hetoḥ ca asiddhiḥ tasya siddhānte cetanā adhiṣṭhāna sattvāt iti ced satyam

original: paraprakriyayā paro dūṣaṇīya iti parasiddhaṃ pakṣādikaṃ parigṛhya idamanumānamukatm| yadvā parānumānasya pratikūlatarkarūpaṃ dūṣaṇānumānamuktam| yadi pradhānaṃ acetanatvesati cetanānadhiṣṭhitaṃ syāt, jagadracanāyāmasamarthaṃ syāt|
analyzed: para prakriyayā paraḥ dūṣaṇīyaḥ iti para siddham pakṣa ādikam parigṛhya idam anumānam ukatm yat vā para anumānasya pratikūla tarka rūpam dūṣaṇānumānam uktam yadi pradhānam acetana tve sati cetanā anadhiṣṭhitam syāt jagat racanāyām asamartham syāt

original: athavā hetorviśeṣyāṃśasya sādhye pratiyogiviśeṣaṇatayā'nvayaḥ, tataśca pradhānaṃ na cetanānadhiṣṭhitaṃ kāryajanakaṃ, acetanatvāt ghaṭagṛhādijanakamṛddārvādivacadityanumānaśarīram| nacānumānika pradhānānabhyupagamādāśrayasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: athavā hetoḥ viśeṣya aṃśasya sādhye pratiyogi viśeṣaṇatayā anvayaḥ tatas ca pradhānam na cetanā anadhiṣṭhitam kārya janakam acetana tvāt ghaṭa gṛha ādi janaka mṛd dārva ādi vat iti anumāna śarīram na ca ānumānika pradhāna anabhyupagamāt āśraya siddhiḥ

original: mahadādikaṃ saprakṛtikaṃ kāryatvādghavaṭadityanumānasya virodhābhāvena siddhānte'bhyupagantuṃ śakyatvāt, sādhye svātaṃtryāpraveśāt, tasyeśvarapārataṃtryamātre śrutyapekṣaṇāt| nanu acetanasya cetanādhiṣṭhitasyaiva pravṛttiriti na niyamaḥ, vṛtsavṛdhyarthaṃ dhenugatasya kṣīrasya svayameva prasravadarśanāt|
analyzed: mahat ādikam sa prakṛtikam kāryatvāt ghavaṭat iti anumānasya virodha abhāvena siddhānta abhyupagantum śakya tvāt sādhye svātaṃtrya apraveśāt tasya īśvara pārataṃtrya mātre śruti apekṣaṇāt nanu acetanasya cetanā dhiṣṭhitasya eva pravṛttiḥ iti na niyamaḥ vṛtsa vṛdhi artham dhenu gatasya kṣīrasya svayam eva prasrava darśanāt

original: sasyavṛdhyarthaṃ vāridamuktasya jalasya svayameva nissaraṇadarśanāt| evaṃ puruṣasya bhogāpavargārthaṃ cetanānadhiṣṭhitasyāpi pradhānasya pravṛttisambhavāditi cenna| kṣīrajalayorapyacetanatvāccetanādhiṣṭhānābhāve pravṛttyasambhavataulyena pakṣa iva pakṣataulye'pi vyabhicārābhāvāt| etena
analyzed: sasya vṛdhi artham vārida muktasya jalasya svayam eva nissaraṇa darśanāt evam puruṣasya bhoga apavarga artham cetanā anadhiṣṭhitasya api pradhānasya pravṛtti sambhavāt iti ced na kṣīra jalayoḥ api acetana tvāt cetanā adhiṣṭhāna abhāve pravṛtti asambhava taulyena pakṣe iva pakṣa taulye api vyabhicāra abhāvāt etena

original: dhenvādyupayuktatṛṇādeḥ kṣīrādibhāvāpattirapi vyākhyātā| tatrāpi cetanādhiṣṭhānāvaśyambhāvena pakṣataulyāt| anyathā cetanaviśeṣasaṅkalpasya niyāmakasyābhāve anaḍuhādyupayuktasyāpi tṛṇādeḥ kṣīrādibhāvaprasaṅgāt| na ca dhainavajāḍharāgnisaṃyoge kaścitpāke viśeṣaḥ| agnisaṃyogamātrasya pākahetutvāt, tasya anaḍuhādijaṭharasaṃyoge'pyaviśeṣāt|

analyzed: na bhavanti tatra catvāri etāni gūḍham prayoktavyāni japaḥ pañca brahama mantrāṇām namaskāraḥ prasiddhaḥ dvārāṇi kāyana spandana mandayāna śrṛṅgāraṇa api tad karaṇa api tad bhāṣaṇa bhedena ṣaḍvidhāni a suptasya iva supliṅga pradarśanam kāyanam vāta vyādhi abhi bhūtasya iva śarīra avayavānām kampanam spandanam upahata pāda indriyasya iva gamanam mandayānam

original: rūpayauvanasampannāṃ kāminīmavalokyātmānaṃ kāmukamiva yairvilāsaiḥ pradarśayati, tadācaraṇaṃ śrṛṅgāraṇam| kāryakāryavivekavikalasyeva lokaninditakarmakaraṇamapitatkaraṇam| vyāhatāpārthakādiśabdoccārāṇamapi tadbhāṣaṇam| duḥkhānto dvividhaḥ| anātmakassātmakaśca| anātmakassarvaduḥkhānāmatyantocchedaḥ| sātmakastu dṛkkriyāśaktibalalakṣaṇamaiśvaryam|
analyzed: rūpa yauvana sampannām kāminīm avalokya ātmānam kāmukam iva yaiḥ vilāsaiḥ pradarśayati tat ācaraṇam śrṛṅgāraṇam kārya kārya viveka vikalasya iva loka nindita karma karaṇam api tat karaṇam tat bhāṣaṇam duḥkhāntaḥ dvividhaḥ anātmakaḥ sātmakaḥ ca anātmakaḥ sarva duḥkhānām atyanta ucchedaḥ sātmakaḥ tu dṛkkriyā śakti bala lakṣaṇam aiśvaryam

original: tatra dṛkchaktirekā'pi vaṣayabhedātpañcadhopacaryate| darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ vijñānaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ ceti| sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭāśeṣacākṣuṣasparśanādiviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ darśanam| aśeṣaśabdaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ śravaṇam| niravaśeṣaśāstraviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ mananam| granthato'rthataścāsandigdhaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānam| sarvajñatvaṃ prasiddham|
analyzed: tatra dṛś śaktiḥ ekā api vaṣaya bhedāt pañcadhā upacaryate darśanam śravaṇam mananam vijñānam sarvajña tvam ca iti sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa aśeṣa cākṣuṣa sparśana ādi viṣayam jñānam darśanam aśeṣa śabda viṣayam jñānam śravaṇam niravaśeṣa śāstra viṣayam jñānam mananam granthatorthataḥ ca asandigdham jñānam vijñānam sarvajña tvam prasiddham

original: kriyāśaktirekā'pi trividhopacaryate - manojavatvaṃ kāmirūpatvaṃ vikaraṇatharmitvañceti| niratiśayaśīghragāmitvaṃ manojavitvam| karmānapekṣya svecchayaivānantaśarīrendriyādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ kāmirūpitvam| upasaṃhṛtaśarīrendriyasyāpi niratiśayaiśvaryaśālitvaṃ vikaraṇadharmitvam| paśupatistu parameśvarassarvatrāpi kārye nimittam|
analyzed: kriyāśaktiḥ ekā api trividhā upacaryate manojava tvam kāmi rūpa tvam vikaraṇa tharmi tvam ca iti niratiśaya śīghragāmi tvam manojavi tvam karma an apekṣya sva icchayā eva ananta śarīra indriya adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam kāmi rūpi tvam upasaṃhṛta śarīra indriyasya api niratiśaya aiśvarya śāli tvam vikaraṇa dharmi tvam paśupatiḥ tu parameśvaraḥ sarvatra api kārye nimittam

original: paśūnāṃ karmānapekṣya svecchayaiva phalapradaḥ| niratiśayasvātaṃtryaśālitvāt| na caivaṃ karmavaiyarthyam| īśvarecchānugṛhītakarmaṇassāphalyāt, tadananugṛhītasya karmaṇaḥ parjanyānanugṛhītakṛṣikarmaṇa iva vaiphalye'pi doṣābhāvāt, tadanugrahasambhāvanayā karmasu pravṛttyupapatteḥ| sṛṣṭikramo'pi tādātvikeśvarecchādhīnaḥ| na tu niyamenākāśādiriti|
analyzed: paśūnām karma an apekṣya sva icchayā eva phala pradaḥ niratiśaya svātaṃtrya śāli tvāt na ca evam karma vaiyarthyam īśvara icchā anugṛhīta karmaṇaḥ sāphalyāt tad ananugṛhītasya karmaṇaḥ parjanya ananugṛhīta kṛṣi karmaṇaḥ iva vaiphalye api doṣa abhāvāt tad anugraha sambhāvanayā karmasu pravṛtti upapatteḥ sṛṣṭi kramaḥ api tādātvika īśvara icchā adhīnaḥ na tu niyamena ākāśa ādiḥ iti

original: evaṃvidhasya pāśupatamatasya kāpālakālāmukhamatābhyāṃ virodhasspaṣṭaḥ| bhasmasnānādeḥ kriyātassāmyepi śavabhasmavat kiṃcidbhasmābhikṣitaṃ bhasmeti grāhyabhasmasvarūpe'sti virodhaḥ| vedenacāsti virodhaḥ| na huḍukārādikaṃ vedeṣu tadupabṛhmaṇeṣu spaṣṭamasti|
analyzed: evaṃvidhasya pāśupata matasya kāpāla kālāmukha matābhyām virodhaḥ spaṣṭaḥ bhasma snāna ādeḥ kriyātaḥ sāmye pi śava bhasma vat kiṃcid bhasma abhikṣitam bhasma iti grāhya bhasma svarūpe asti virodhaḥ vedena ca asti virodhaḥ na huḍukāra ādikam vedeṣu tad upabṛhmaṇeṣu spaṣṭam asti

original: śrṛṅgāraṇaṃ bhasmasnānānusnānābhyāṃ pratyāmnānatayā jalasnanaṃ jalaśuddhinivartanaṃ prāṇikarmaniyatasṛjyakramānapekṣaṇañcātyaṃtaṃ vedamārgaviruddhaṃ| evaṃ kāpālādiśaivatrayaṃ parasparavirodhādvedavirodhāccāsamaṃjasamiti siddhaṃ| yadyapi siddhāṃtaśaivasya nātyaṃtaṃ vedavirodhosti|
analyzed: śrṛṅgāraṇam bhasma snāna anusnānābhyām pratyāmnānatayā jala snanam jala śuddhi nivartanam prāṇi karma niyata sṛjya krama anapekṣaṇam ca atyaṃtam veda mārga viruddham evam kāpāla ādi śaiva trayam paraspara virodhāt veda virodhāt ca asamaṃjasam iti siddham yadi api siddhāṃta śaivasya na atyaṃtam veda virodhaḥ usti

original: vedavirodhābhāve ca kāmikādivātulāṃtānāmaṣṭāviṃśatitaṃtrarūpāṇāmavāṃtarabhedānāṃ parasparavirodhastvāgamasiddhāṃta divyasiddhāṃtataṃtrasiddhāṃtataṃtrāṃtarasiddhāṃtarūpapāṃcarātrāvāṃtarataṃtrabhedaparasparavirodhavat tattattaṃtragīkṣitādhikāribhedena samādhātuṃ śakyaḥ|
analyzed: veda virodha abhāve ca kāmika ādi vātula aṃtānām aṣṭāviṃśati taṃtra rūpāṇām avāṃtara bhedānām paraspara virodhaḥ tu āgama siddhāṃta divya siddhāṃta taṃtra siddhāṃta taṃtra aṃtara siddhāṃta rūpa pāṃcarātra avāṃtara taṃtra bheda paraspara virodha vat tad tad taṃtra gīkṣita adhikāri bhedena samādhātum śakyaḥ

original: kāmikādiṣu śivāgamasya vedādutkarṣoktiśca pāṃcarātrasya tata utkarṣoktivat samādhātuṃ śakyā| tathāpi vedaprāmāmyamaṃgīkṛtyāpi vedaṃ pracchādya siddhāṃtaśaivataṃtreṣu yadanumānenaiveśvaraprasādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ tannūnaṃ yathāvedamīśvarābhyupagame prāyaḥ kāraṇavākyeṣu puruṣottamāsādhāraṇena nārāyaṇanāmnā kāraṇavastunirdeśāt sa eva jagatkāraṇaṃ parabrahma
analyzed: kāmika ādiṣu śiva āgamasya vedāt utkarṣa uktiḥ ca pāṃcarātrasya tatas utkarṣa ukti vat samādhātum śakyā tathā api veda prāmāmyam aṃgīkṛtya api vedam pracchādya siddhāṃta śaiva taṃtreṣu yat anumānena eva īśvara prasādhanam kṛtam tat nūnam yathāvedam īśvara abhyupagame prāyas kāraṇa vākyeṣu puruṣottama asādhāraṇena nārāyaṇa nāmnā kāraṇa vastu nirdeśāt saḥ eva jagat kāraṇam para brahma

original: bhediti tatpracchādanārthamityavasīyate| atasteṣāmanumāneneśvaraprasādhanamātrasyāsāmañjasyamudbhāvayāmaḥ| loke kulālamṛtpiṇḍādibhedadarśanena hi śrutisiddhajagannimittopādānābhedamavigaṇayyānumānena kevalanimitteśvaraḥ prasādhyate| tarhi lokadarśanenaiva śarīritvamapyaṃgīkaraṇīyaṃ| śarīriṇa eva kulālādeḥ kartṛtvadarśanāt|
analyzed: bhed iti tat pracchādana artham iti avasīyate atas teṣām anumānena īśvara prasādhana mātrasya asāmañjasyam udbhāvayāmaḥ loke kulāla mṛd piṇḍa ādi bheda darśanena hi śruti siddha jagat nimitta upādāna abhedam a vigaṇayya anumānena kevala nimitta īśvaraḥ prasādhyate tarhi loka darśanena eva śarīri tvam api aṃgīkaraṇīyam śarīriṇaḥ eva kulāla ādeḥ kartṛ tva darśanāt

original: na cādhiṣṭeyaṃ māyādikameva tasya śarīraṃ bhavet, svaśarīravyāpārenāt| na cādhiṣṭheyaṃ māyādikameva tasya śarīraṃ bhavet, svaśarīravyāpāre niyamyātiriktaśarīrānapekṣaṇasya dṛṣṭatvāditi vācyaṃ| na hi śarīramātramāpādayāmaḥ| kintu bhogāśrayarūpaṃ| bhogārthaṃ tathābhūtaṃ śarīramadhitiṣṭhato hi sukhārthaṃ duḥkhaparihārārthaṃ vā kvācitkatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ|
analyzed: na ca adhiṣṭheyam māyā ādikam eva tasya śarīram bhavet na ca adhiṣṭheyam māyā ādikam eva tasya śarīram bhavet sva śarīra vyāpāre niyamya atirikta śarīra anapekṣaṇasya dṛṣṭa tvāt iti vācyam na hi śarīra mātram āpādayāmaḥ kintu bhoga āśraya rūpam bhoga artham tathābhūtam śarīram adhitiṣṭhataḥ hi sukha artham duḥkha parihāra artham vā kvācitkatvam dṛṣṭam

original: tathā ca kartṛtvanirvāhārthaṃ bhogāśrayaśarīrābhyupagame tanmūlapuṇyapāpavatvaṃ, śarīrasyānityatvaniyamāt antavatvaṃ, jananamaraṇāvṛttimatāṃ kiñcijjñatvadṛṣṭerasarvajñatvaṃ ca, syāt| ato'numāneneśvarasiddhimicchatāṃ yathābhimatarūpa īśvaro nasidhyediti|
analyzed: tathā ca kartṛ tva nirvāha artham bhoga āśraya śarīra abhyupagame tad mūla puṇya pāpavatvam śarīrasya anitya tva niyamāt antavatvam janana maraṇa āvṛttimatām kiñcijjñatva dṛṣṭeḥ asarvajñatvam ca syāt atas anumānena īśvara siddhim icchatām yathā abhimata rūpaḥ īśvaraḥ na sidhyet iti

original: yattu śāsrayonitvādhikaraṇe anumāneneśvarasiddhau īśvarānekatvādikamapi sidhyediti duṣaṇamuktaṃ, tadapyatratyaduṣaṇameva| atraiva sūtrakārasyānumānadūṣaṇakaṃṭhoktidarśanāt| tatra tu sūtrakṛtāṃ "taṃtvaupaniṣadami"tyādiśrutitātparyavicāremaiva parameśvarasya śāstrayonitvaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ| ato na tena paunaruktyaṃ|
analyzed: yat tu śāsra yoni tva adhikaraṇe anumānena īśvara siddhau īśvara anekatva ādikam api sidhyet iti duṣaṇam uktam tat api atratya duṣaṇam eva atra eva sūtrakārasya anumāna dūṣaṇa kaṃṭha ukti darśanāt tatra tu sūtrakṛtām parameśvarasya śāstra yoni tvam vyavasthāpitam atas na tena paunaruktyam

original: "racanāṃnupapatte"śceti sāṃkhyādhikaraṇe mṛdghaṭādinyāyena sukhaduḥkhamohātmakasya jagatastatsarūpeṇa kāraṇena
analyzed: racanā anupapatteḥ ca iti sāṃkhya adhikaraṇe mṛd ghaṭa ādi nyāyena sukha duḥkha moha ātmakasya jagataḥ tad sarūpeṇa kāraṇena

original: bhavitavyamityanumimānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ prati tarhi tadṛṣṭāṃtenaiva cenādhiṣṭhānenaiva bhāvyamityetāvanmātramāpāditaṃ| na tu svataṃtramīśvarānumānamanavadyamiti teneśvaraḥ prasādhitaḥ| atastatreśvarānumānamanumoditaṃ| iha dūṣitamiti na virodhaḥ|
analyzed: bhavitavyam iti anumimānam sāṃkhyam prati tarhi tad dṛṣṭāṃtena eva cena adhiṣṭhānena eva bhāvyam iti etāvat mātram āpāditam na tu svataṃtram īśvara anumānam anavadyam iti tena īśvaraḥ prasādhitaḥ atas tatra īśvara anumānam anumoditam iha dūṣitam iti na virodhaḥ

original: pāśupatavat pāñcarātrasyāpi taṃtratvenāprāmāṇyamāśaṃkya nirasyata iti saṃgatiḥ| pāñcarātriṇo bhāgavatā manyante - bhagavānnārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahma savāsudevādicaturvyūhātmanā'vatiṣṭhate| tatra vāsudevaḥ paripūrṇaṣāḍguṇyaśālī| ṣaḍguṇāstu jñānabalaiśvaryaśaktitejāṃsi|
analyzed: pāśupata vat pāñcarātrasya api taṃtra tvena aprāmāṇyam āśaṃkya nirasyate iti saṃgatiḥ pāñcarātriṇaḥ bhāgavatāḥ manyante bhagavān nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahma sa vāsudeva ādi catur vyūha ātmanā avatiṣṭhate tatra vāsudevaḥ paripūrṇa ṣāḍguṇya śālī ṣaḍguṇāḥ tu jñāna bala aiśvarya śakti tejāṃsi

original: tatra cetanācetanātmakasakalaprapañcagatāśeṣaviśeṣollokhitatayā sakalavastugocaraṃ tasya jñānaṃ jñānamucyate| jagatprakṛtibhāvaśśaktiḥ| jagatsṛjato'sya śramābhāvastilakālakavadaprayatnena svasṛṣṭasakalajagadbharaṇañca balam| apratihatecchatvamaiśvaryam| jagatprakṛtitve'pi payaso dadhibhāveneva vikāraviraho vīryam|
analyzed: tatra cetana acetana ātmaka sakala prapañca gata aśeṣa viśeṣa ullokhita tayā sakala vastu gocaram tasya jñānam jñānam ucyate jagat prakṛti bhāvaḥ śaktiḥ jagat sṛjataḥ asya śrama abhāvaḥ tilakālaka vat aprayatnena sva sṛṣṭa sakala jagat bharaṇam ca balam apratihata icchatvam aiśvaryam jagat prakṛti tve pi payasaḥ dadhi bhāvena iva vikāra virahaḥ vīryam

original: jagatsṛṣṭau sahakāryanapekṣatvaṃ parābhibhavasāmarthyañca tejaḥ| tato jñānabalonmeṣeṇa saṅkarṣaṇarūpaḥ prādurbhavati| tato vīryaiśvaryonmeṣeṇa pradyumnarūpāḥ| tataśśaktitejassamunmeṣeṇāniruddharūpaḥ|| saṅkarṣaṇādayaśca jīvamano'haṅkārūrapāḥ|
analyzed: jagat sṛṣṭau sahakāri anapekṣa tvam para abhibhava sāmarthyam ca tejaḥ tatas jñāna bala unmeṣeṇa saṅkarṣaṇa rūpaḥ prādurbhavati tatas vīrya aiśvarya unmeṣeṇa pradyumna rūpāḥ tatas śakti tejaḥ samunmeṣeṇa aniruddha rūpaḥ saṅkarṣaṇa ādayaḥ ca jīva manaḥ haṅkā arūrapāḥ

original: evaṃ caturvyūhaṃ bhagavantaṃ pratyahaṃ pāñcakālikenābhigamanādipañcakena vārṣaśatikādivratena samārādhya puruṣaḥ kleśairmucyate| tatrābhigamanaṃ prātarbhagavanmantrajapastutinamaskārādikam| tataḥ pūjārthapuṣpādispādanamupādānam| tataḥ pūjanamijyā| tato bhagavacchāstratadanuguṇapurāṇāgamaśravaṇādikaṃ svādhyāyaḥ|
analyzed: evam catur vyūham bhagavantam pratyaham pāñcakālikena abhigamana ādi pañcakena vārṣaśatika ādi vratena samārādhya puruṣaḥ kleśaiḥ mucyate tatra abhigamanam prātar bhagavat mantra japa stuti namaskāra ādikam tatas pūjā artha puṣpa ādi spādanam upādānam tatas pūjanam ijyā tatas bhagavat śāstra tad anuguṇa purāṇa āgama śravaṇa ādikam svādhyāyaḥ

original: tatassāyaṃsandhyānantaraṃ bhagavati cittasamādhānaṃ yoga iti| tadidamayuktamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ| tathā hi - pāñcarātre jīvasyotpattirāmnāyate| "vāsudevātsaṅkarṣaṇo nāma jīvo jāyate| saṅkarṣaṇātpradyumnasaṃjñaṃ mano jāyate| tasmādaniruddhasaṃjño'haṅkāro jāyata" iti| na ca jīvasyānāderutpattissambhavati|
analyzed: tatas sāyaṃsandhyā anantaram bhagavati citta samādhānam yogaḥ iti tat idam ayuktam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tathā hi pāñcarātre jīvasya utpattiḥ āmnāyate vāsudevāt saṅkarṣaṇaḥ nāma jīvaḥ jāyate saṅkarṣaṇāt pradyumna saṃjñam manaḥ jāyate tasmāt aniruddha saṃjñaḥ uhaṅkāraḥ jāyate iti na ca jīvasya anādeḥ utpattiḥ sambhavati

original: na ca saṅkarṣaṇādīnāṃ jīvādyabhimānitvamanenocyata iti vācyam| tathā sati "saṅkarṣaṇo nāma jīva" ityādyanupapatteḥ| anena hi prasiddhānāmeva jīvamano'haṅkārāṇāṃ pāñcarātraparibhāṣayā saṅkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhanāmāni vidhīyante|

original: na ca vyāptyasiddhiḥ, cetanānadhiṣṭhitasya kāryārambhakatvānupapatteḥ, cetanādhiṣṭhitasyaiva kāryārambhapravṛttessarvatra darśanācca| nanu siddhānte pakṣāsiddhiḥ| naca "pradhānakṣetrajñapatirguṇeśa" iti śrutisiddhaṃ pradhānaṃ siddhānte'pyastīti vācyam| tasyānumānagamyatvābhāvena karmavyutpanna sūtrānumānapadanirdeśyatvāyogāt|

original: tatra paramāṇuvādinovaibhāṣikasautrāntikāevamāhuḥ - rūparasagandhasparśasvabhāvāḥ pārthivāḥ paramāṇavaḥ rūparasasparśasvabhāvāāpyāḥ, rūpasparśasvabhāvāstaijasāḥ, sparśasvabhāvāvāyavīyāḥ, bhūsūdharasamudrabaḍabānalamahāvāyvātmakabhūtarūpeṇa saṃhanyante| tebhyaśca pṛthivyādibhyaḥ śarīrendriyaghaṭādiviṣayarūpabhautikasaṃghātābhavanti|

original: śuktirajatabhrāṃtirūpāvidyārajatarāgādinā'pi śukteśśuktirūpasamudāyatāprahāṇena rajatarūpasamudāyatāpattiprasaṃgāt| anyasyāvidyayānyasya rāgādijanane'tiprasaṃgenāvidyārāgādipravāhānupapatteśca| syādetadanyasya karmaṇā anyatra saṃyogajanane'tiprasaṃgaitidoṣo na bauddhamate prasarati| na hi taiḥ kṣaṇikeṣu paramāṇvādiṣu karmasaṃyogāvabhyupagamyete|

original: kintu deśāntarasthena deśāntarasthasyotpādaḥ sakarmapratyayasyālambanaṃ, viprakṛṣṭadeśena sannikṛṣṭadeśasya utpādaḥ sasaṃyogapratyayasya| tataśca yathā nyāyamate nānādikprabhavaśabdamūlakaśabdaparamparājananakrameṇa bahūnāṃ śabdānāṃ melane sati kolāhalapratyayaḥ, evaṃ bahūnāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ tathā puñjībhāvesati bhūbhūdharādipratyayaḥ|
analyzed: kintu deśa antara sthena deśa antara sthasya utpādaḥ sa karma pratyayasya ālambanam viprakṛṣṭa deśena sannikṛṣṭa deśasya utpādaḥ sa saṃyoga pratyayasya tatas ca yathā nyāya mate nānā diś prabhava śabda mūlaka śabda paramparā janana krameṇa bahūnām śabdānām melane sati kolāhala pratyayaḥ evam bahūnām paramāṇūnām tathā puñjībhāve sati bhū bhūdhara ādi pratyayaḥ

original: dṛṣṭaṃhyekaikasya keśasya dūre dṛśyatvābhāve'pi bahūnāṃ keśānāṃ kavaryādirūpeṇa puñjībhāvesati tatsamudāyasya dṛśyatvaṃ| na cādṛśyasamudāyasyā dṛśyatvaniyamaḥ| aprayojakatvāt|

original: dvividho'pyayaṃ niranvayavināśo na sambhavati| avicchedāt| sadaivāvicchinnatayā'nuvartamānasya dravyasya pūrvāvasthāprahāṇottarāvasthāpattibhyāmeva nāśotpattivyavahāraḥ| na tu dravyasya kvidapi niranvayavināśo'stītyārambhaṇādhikaraṇe samarthitatvāt| ato vināśasya kāraṇatvaṃ na sambhavati| "ākāśaṃ dvau nirodhau ca nityaṃ trayamasaṃskṛtam|

original: bauddhaiḥ "saṃskṛtaṃ kāryamevānityaṃ, asaṃskṛtamakāryamākāśāditrayaṃ tu nitya"miti nityatvenābhyupagatasya nirodhadvayasya kāraṇatvānupapatteśca, avicchedenānuvartamānasya kāraṇatve sadā sarvatra sarvakāryotpattiprasaṅgāt| tatsahakāritvenābhimatānāmapi nirodhadvayasya nityatvāt|
analyzed: bauddhaiḥ saṃskṛtam kāryam eva anityam asaṃskṛtam akāryam ākāśa ādi trayam tu nityam iti nitya tvena abhyupagatasya nirodha dvayasya kāraṇa tva anupapatteḥ ca avicchedena anuvartamānasya kāraṇa tve sadā sarvatra sarva kārya utpatti prasaṅgāt tad sahakāri tvena abhimatānām api nirodha dvayasya nitya tvāt

original: kiṃ ca nirodhadvayaṃ ākāśaṃ ceti trayamavasthātmakaṃ tucchamiti bauddhā manyante| tatra tucchāt kathaṃ jagadutpattiḥ? tucchādutpattau tucchasya nirviśeṣatvena kāraṇaviśeṣakṛtakāryaviśeṣa vyavasthityasambhavāt ghaṭakṣaṇānantaraṃ sarvasya jagata utpattissyāt| tucchādutpadyamānañca kāryaṃ tucchameva syāt| tasya sadrūpatayā pratītirna syāt|

original: suvarṇarucakādinyāyena kāraṇānusāritvāt kāryasya| apica - ākāśamapi tucchamiti bauddhairucyate| tatkathamupapadyate| pratīyate hi spaṣṭamākāśaṃ "atra śyenaḥ patati, atra gṛdhra"iti śyenādipatanadeśatvena| nanviyaṃ pratītiścandrasūryālokaviṣayatvenopapadyate| mahāndhakāre "khadyota iha patatī"ti pratītiḥ khadyotaprakāśaviṣayatvenopapadyate|

original: "prāgbhāge'vakāśo'sti na pratyagbhāge bhuñjānairnibiḍa" iti kvaciddeśe avakāśaniṣedho'pi dṛśyate| na hyākāśasya tatra niṣedhassambhavati| sarvagatatvāt| asarvagatatve cāvaraṇāpāye'pyavakāśābhāvaprasaṅgāt| nahi pūrvamasannākāśaḥ| evaṃ ca mūrtadravyābhāva evāvakāśaḥ tattadupādhyavacchinnaḥ prāgādivyahārālambanamastītyapi śaṅkā nirastā|
analyzed: prāgbhāga ivakāśaḥ usti na pratyak bhāge bhuñjānaiḥ nibiḍaḥ iti kvacid deśe avakāśa niṣedhaḥ api dṛśyate na hi ākāśasya tatra niṣedhaḥ sambhavati sarvagata tvāt asarvagata tve ca āvaraṇa apāye pi avakāśa abhāva prasaṅgāt nahi pūrvam asan ākāśaḥ evam ca mūrta dravya abhāvaḥ eva avakāśaḥ tat tad upādhi avacchinnaḥ prāk ādi vyahāra ālambanam asti iti api śaṅkā nirastā

original: tasya deśādheyatvena pratīteḥ, "prāgbhāge'vakāśo nāsti tatra nīrandhramāsate dvijā" iti āvaraṇābhāvarūpāvakāśapratiṣedhe'pi prāgādideśasattvavyavahārācca| nacaiva māvaraṇābhāvarūpāvakāśasyeva prāgbhāgādirūpadeśasyāpi deśādheyatvena vyavahāro'sti| yena tato'pi vyatirikto deśassidhyet| ayaṃ prāgdeśa ityādireva hi vyavahāraḥ|
analyzed: tasya deśa ādheya tvena pratīteḥ prāc bhāga ivakāśaḥ nā asti tatra nīrandhram āsate dvijāḥ iti āvaraṇa abhāva rūpa avakāśa pratiṣedhe pi prāc ādi deśa sattva vyavahārāt ca na ca eva mā āvaraṇa abhāva rūpa avakāśasya iva prāc bhāga ādi rūpa deśasya api deśa ādheya tvena vyavahāraḥ usti yena tatas api vyatiriktaḥ deśaḥ sidhyet ayam prāc deśaḥ ityādiḥ eva hi vyavahāraḥ

original: na tvasmin deśe prāgdeśe ityādirūpaḥ| "ihākāśa" ityapi laukikapratītestadvyatirikto deśassyāditi cenna| laukikānāmākāśapratīterupari paritaścāvāṅmukhendranīlamahākaṭāhavadavabhāsamāne meruśikhara ratnaprabhāviśeṣatvenāgamasiddhe nīladravya eva vyavasthitatvāt tasya digviśeṣādheyatvena pratītyavirodhāt|
analyzed: na tu asmin deśe prāc deśe ityādi rūpaḥ iha ākāśe iti api laukika pratīteḥ tad vyatiriktaḥ deśaḥ syāt iti ced na laukikānām ākāśa pratīteḥ upari paritas ca avāṅmukha indranīla mahā kaṭāha vat avabhāsamāne meru śikhara ratna prabhā viśeṣa tvena āgama siddhe nīla dravye eva vyavasthita tvāt tasya diś viśeṣa ādheya tvena pratīti avirodhāt

original: deśarūpasyākāśasya "idānīmiha ghaṭa" ityādi pratītiṣu kālavat padārthaviṣayatvena bhānaṃvinā kvacidapi laukikapratītau svātaṃtryeṇa bhānānaṅgīkārāt| tasmādākāśasya prāmāṇikatvāt "ākāśaṃ nirodhadvayamiti tucchatrayameva nityaṃ, sadrūpamanyatsarvaṃ kṣaṇika"mityetadayuktaṃ| nanu kṣaṇikatvaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ kathaṃ pratyākhyāyate|
analyzed: deśa rūpasya ākāśasya idānīm iha ghaṭaḥ ityādi pratītiṣu kāla vat padārtha viṣayatvena bhānam vinā kvacid api laukika pratītau svātaṃtryeṇa bhāna anaṅgīkārāt tasmāt ākāśasya prāmāṇika tvāt ākāśam nirodha dvayam iti tuccha trayam eva nityam sat rūpam anyat sarvam kṣaṇikam iti etat ayuktam nanu kṣaṇika tvam prāmāṇikam katham pratyākhyāyate

original: pratyakṣaṃ hi vartamānavastuviṣayaṃ, avartamānādatītāt pūrvakṣaṇavartino'nāgatāccottarakṣaṇavartinassvaviṣayaṃ vyāvṛttamavagamayati|
analyzed: pratyakṣam hi vartamāna vastu viṣayam avartamānāt atītāt pūrva kṣaṇa vartinaḥ unāgatāt ca uttara kṣaṇa vartinaḥ sva viṣayam vyāvṛttam avagamayati

original: yathā "nīlo ghaṭa" iti nailyaviśiṣṭapratyakṣaṃ aruṇādivyāvṛttaṃ ghaṭamavagamayatīticet ucyate - udāhṛtamabhijñājñānaṃ ghaṭasya vartamānakālasambandhamiva "so'yaṃ ghaṭa" iti pratyabhijñānaṃ tasyāvartamānakālasambanadhamapi viṣayīkaroti|
analyzed: yathā nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti nailya viśiṣṭa pratyakṣam aruṇa ādi vyāvṛttam ghaṭam avagamayati iti ced ucyate udāhṛtam abhijñā jñānam ghaṭasya vartamāna kāla sambandham iva saḥ uyam ghaṭaḥ iti pratyabhijñānam tasya avartamāna kāla sambanadham api viṣayīkaroti

original: atastadanusārādekasya vartamānāvartamānakāladvaya sambandhasiddhau kramikatvena kāladvayasyāvirodhopapatteśca vartamānakālasambandhaviṣayaṃ jñānamayogavyavaccedamavagamayet nānyayogavyavacchekaṃ svāvacchedena vā'nyayogavyavacchedaṃ| na tu sarvātmanā| ata eva citrapaṭe nailyajñānaṃ nānīlavyāvṛtiṃta gamayati| pradeśaviśeṣāvacchedena vā tāṃ gamayati|
analyzed: atas tad anusārāt ekasya vartamāna a vartamāna kāla dvaya sambandha siddhau kramika tvena kāla dvayasya avirodha upapatteḥ ca vartamāna kāla sambandha viṣayam jñānam ayogavyavat ca idam avagamayet na anya yoga vyavacchekam sva avacchedena vā anya yoga vyavacchedam na tu sarva ātmanā atas eva citra paṭe nailya jñānam gamayati pradeśa viśeṣa avacchedena vā tām gamayati

original: na hi dharmayoravirodho dharmibhedenaivopapādanīyaḥ| api tu sāmānādhikaraṇyapramityanudayenāpi| tadudaye tu svamanīṣikāmātrakalpito virodho na prāmāṇikānāṃ hṛdayaṃgamaḥ| nanu smṛtipratyakṣayoḥ klṛptakāraṇābhyāṃ "sa" iti "ayaṃ ghaṭa" iti ca smṛnyanubhavarūpaṃ jñānadvayameva bhavitu marhati| na pratyabhijñārūpamekajñānamiti cenna|
analyzed: na hi dharmayoḥ avirodhaḥ dharmi bhedena eva upapādanīyaḥ api tu sāmānādhikaraṇya pramiti anudayena api tad udaye tu sva manīṣikā mātra kalpitaḥ virodhaḥ na prāmāṇikānām hṛdayaṃgamaḥ nanu smṛti pratyakṣayoḥ klṛpta kāraṇābhyām saḥ iti ayam ghaṭaḥ iti ca smṛni anubhava rūpam jñāna dvayam eva bhavitu marhati na pratyabhijñā rūpam eka jñānam iti ced na

original: tadidaṃ mayā nihitaṃ rajatamiti tadarthina idamarthe pravṛttidarśanena pratyabhijñānasyaikajñānatvasiddhau tatra kāryabalāt tatra saṃskāra pratyāsattisahitamindriyaṃ kāraṇamiti kalpanopapatteḥ| nanu tathā'pi pratyabhijñābhrāntirūpaiva
analyzed: tat idam mayā nihitam rajatam iti tad arthinaḥ idam arthe pravṛtti darśanena pratyabhijñānasya eka jñāna tva siddhau tatra kārya balāt tatra saṃskāra pratyāsatti sahitam indriyam kāraṇam iti kalpanā upapatteḥ nanu tathā api pratyabhijñā bhrānti rūpā eva

original: kramasaṃvardhamāneṣu tarugulmalatādiṣu santatasantanyamānābayavopacayāpacayavatsu girisamudrādiṣvatayantavilakṣaṇeṣu bālavārdhakyāpannaśarīreṣvapi dṛśyate| ataḥ kūṭasākṣiṇī pratyabhijñā na kvāpi pramāṇamiti cenna| udāhṛtapratyabhijñānasyāvasthābhede'pyavasthāvaddravyaikyaviṣayatvena prāmāṇyopapatteḥ|
analyzed: krama saṃvardhamāneṣu taru gulma latā ādiṣu santata santanyamāna abayava upacaya apacayavatsu giri samudra ādiṣu atayanta vilakṣaṇeṣu bāla vārdhakya āpanna śarīreṣu api dṛśyate atas kūṭa sākṣiṇī pratyabhijñā na kvāpi pramāṇam iti ced na udāhṛta pratyabhijñānasya avasthā bhede pi avasthāvat dravya aikya viṣaya tvena prāmāṇya upapatteḥ

original: na hi pratyabhijñānasya avasthaikyaṃ viṣayaḥ yenāprāmāṇyaṃ bhavet| kiṃ tvavasthāvaddravyaikyameva| na ca āgamāpāyyavasthātirekeṇānekāvasthānuyāyidravyameva nāstīti vācyam| tasminnantata udāhṛtapratyabhijñānāmeva prāmāṇyasidhyā tatpratyākhyānāyogāt| jvālālūnapunarjātakeśanakhādipratyabhijñāmātrasya sādṛśyanibandhanabhrāntitvakalpanamapi na yuktam|
analyzed: na hi pratyabhijñānasya avasthā aikyam viṣayaḥ yena aprāmāṇyam bhavet kim tu avasthāvat dravya aikyam eva na ca āgama apāyi avasthā atirekeṇa aneka avasthā anuyāyi dravyam eva na asti iti vācyam tasmin antatas udāhṛta pratyabhijñānām eva prāmāṇya sidhyā tad pratyākhyāna ayogāt jvālā lūna punar jāta keśa nakha ādi pratyabhijñā mātrasya sādṛśya nibandhana bhrānti tva kalpanam api na yuktam

original: vādhitajñānadṛṣṭāntena abādhitajñānānāmapyaprāmāṇyakalpane pramāṇena vastusiddhimātrasya lopaprasaṅgāt| etena yadbauddhā vadanti - "smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūte'rthe darśanaṃ vārtamānike| tayoratyantabhede ca kenābhedaḥ pratīyatām|| rūpaśaktyādibhedena bālādvṛddho'tibhedavān| parasminpūrvarūpasya na leśo'pyupalabhyate||
analyzed: vādhita jñāna dṛṣṭāntena abādhita jñānānām api aprāmāṇya kalpane pramāṇena vastu siddhi mātrasya lopa prasaṅgāt etena yat bauddhāḥ vadanti smṛtiḥ pūrva anubhūtā ṛthe darśanam vārtamānike tayoḥ atyanta bhede ca kena abhedaḥ pratīyatām rūpa śakti ādi bhedena bālāt vṛddhā ūti bhedavān parasmin pūrva rūpasya na leśaḥ api upalabhyate

original: parasyāpi na pūrvatra kathamekantu tadbhavet| avasthānāmayaṃ bhedo nāvasthānavato yadi|| avasthā eva dṛśyante na svapne'pi tato para"miti| nanu idaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇikatvanirākaraṇahetujālaṃ vaibhāṣikamata iva na sautrāntikame pravartate| tatra yatpratyakṣaviṣayasya tatkāraṇatvaṃ na syāditi pratyabhijñāvirodhāpādanaṃ tattāvannapravartate|
analyzed: parasya api na pūrvatra katham ekam tu tat bhavet avasthānām ayam bhedaḥ na avasthānavataḥ yadi avasthāḥ eva dṛśyante na svapne pi param iti nanu idam sarvam kṣaṇikatva nirākaraṇa hetu jālam vaibhāṣika mate iva na pravartate tatra yat pratyakṣa viṣayasya tat kāraṇa tvam na syāt iti pratyabhijñā virodha āpādanam tat tāvat na pravartate

original: sā hi pratijñā bāhyārthapratyakṣatvavādināmeva| yacca kṣaṇikatvakalpanasya pratyabhijñāpratyakṣeṇa bādhavacanaṃ na tadapi pravartate| bāhyārtheṣu pratyakṣapratyabhijñāyāmasiddheḥ| evañca "ghaṭādi kṣaṇikaṃ arthakriyākāritvāt śarīrādivaditi bauddhānāṃ kṣaṇikatvānumānamapi pratyabhijñānabādhāsidhyā nirupaplavaṃ|
analyzed: sā hi pratijñā bāhya artha pratyakṣa tva vādinām eva yat ca kṣaṇikatva kalpanasya pratyabhijñā pratyakṣeṇa bādha vacanam na tat api pravartate bāhya artheṣu pratyakṣa pratyabhijñāyām asiddheḥ evam ca ghaṭa ādi kṣaṇikam arthakriyā kāri tvāt śarīra ādi vat iti bauddhānām kṣaṇikatva anumānam api pratyabhijñāna bādhā sidhyā nirupaplavam

original: asti cātravipakṣabādhakatarkasssatvocchittiprasaṃgaḥ| arthakriyākāryatvameva hi sattvaṃ| na tatonyajjātyādirūpaṃ| pramāṇābhāvāt| taccanthāyi vapakṣe na saṃbhavati| tathā hi - sthāyī bhāvaḥ svīyāmarthakriyāṃ krameṇa kuryāt yugapadvā| ādye kālāṃtarabhāvinīṃ pratyapi idānīṃ samartho vā na vā|
analyzed: asti ca atra vipakṣa bādhaka tarkaḥ satva ucchitti prasaṃgaḥ arthakriyā kāryatvam eva hi sattvam na tatonyat jāti ādi rūpam pramāṇa abhāvāt na saṃbhavati tathā hi sthāyī bhāvaḥ svīyām arthakriyām krameṇa kuryāt yugapad vā ādye kāla aṃtara bhāvinīm prati api idānīm samarthaḥ vā na vā

original: prathametābadinānīmeva kuryāt| nahīdānīmasamarthaḥ kālāntare samartho bhavati| yugapaditi pakṣe tvidānīmeva kartavyasya sarvasya kṛtatvāt kālāntare samarthe bhavati| yugapaditi pakṣe tvidānīmeva kartavyasya sarvasya kṛtatvāt kālāntare tasyāsattvaṃ bhavet| nanu iha kṣaṇikatvānumāne asti prabalaḥ pratikūlatarkaḥ|
analyzed: prathama itābat inānīm eva kuryāt nahi idānīm asamarthaḥ kāla antare samarthaḥ bhavati yugapad iti pakṣe tu idānīm eva kartavyasya sarvasya kṛta tvāt kāla antare samarthe bhavati yugapad iti pakṣe tu idānīm eva kartavyasya sarvasya kṛta tvāt kāla antare tasya asattvam bhavet nanu iha kṣaṇika tva anumāne asti prabalaḥ pratikūla tarkaḥ

original: kṣaṇikatve hi tvaduktavipakṣabādhakatarkopi na pravartate| tadupayogyāpādyāpādakabhūyassahacāradarśanopādhyabhāvāvadhāraṇa vyāptigrahaṇādīnāmaikādhikaraṇyaniyamāt| maivaṃ| evamādīnāmaikādhikaraṇyaniyame kṣaṇikatvavādināmasaṃpratipatteḥ| atiprasaṃgaśaṃkā tu kāryakāraṇabhāvasya niyāmakatvena nivāraṇīyā|
analyzed: kṣaṇikatve hi tvad ukta vipakṣa bādhaka tarkaḥ api na pravartate tad upayogi āpādya āpādaka bhūyas sahacāra darśana upādhi abhāva avadhāraṇa vyāpti grahaṇa ādīnām aika adhikaraṇya niyamāt mā evam evamādīnām aika adhikaraṇya niyame kṣaṇikatva vādinām asaṃpratipatteḥ atiprasaṃga śaṃkā tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya niyāmaka tvena nivāraṇīyā

original: caitramaitrādayohi pratyekaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvāpannaniraṃtarasantanyāmānālayavijñānakṣaṇanicayātmakāḥ| tasmāt sautrāṃtikapakṣe na kopi doṣa ityadhikayā pratyavatiṣṭhamānānāṃ sautrāṃtikānāṃ matamitthaṃ - jñānagatairnīlādyākāraiḥ bāhyārthagatāste'numīyaṃte| indriyasannikṛṣṭena nīlādyarthena jāyamānaṃ hi jñānaṃ svayamapyarthavannīlādyākāraṃ bhavati|
analyzed: caitra maitra ādayaḥ hi pratyekam kārya kāraṇa bhāva āpanna niraṃtara santa nyāmāna ālayavijñāna kṣaṇa nicaya ātmakāḥ tasmāt sautrāṃtika pakṣe na kaḥ api doṣaḥ iti adhikayā pratyavatiṣṭhamānānām sautrāṃtikānām matam ittham jñāna gataiḥ nīla ādi ākāraiḥ bāhya artha gatāḥ indriya sannikṛṣṭena nīla ādi arthena jāyamānam hi jñānam svayam api arthavat nīla ādi ākāram bhavati

original: tajjñānaṃ svaprakāśatayā svātmānaṃ viṣayīkurvat svagataṃ nīlādyarthino bahiḥ pravṛttistu nāparokṣajñānāt| kintu tadanantarabhāvina ānumānikajñānāt| yathā vāyuniṣevaṇārthinaśśākhācalanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vakṣamūle pravṛttiḥ| na cākṣuṣaśākhācalanajñānāt| kintu talliṃgavāyusañcāraviṣayānumānikajñānāditi|
analyzed: tat jñānam sva prakāśa tayā sva ātmānam viṣayīkurvat svagatam nīla ādi arthinaḥ bahis pravṛttiḥ tu na aparokṣa jñānāt kintu tad anantara bhāvinaḥ ānumānika jñānāt yathā vāyu niṣevaṇa arthinaḥ śākhā calanam dṛṣṭvā vakṣa mūle pravṛttiḥ na cākṣuṣa śākhā calana jñānāt kintu tad liṃga vāyu sañcāra viṣaya ānumānika jñānāt iti

original: tatredaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ - indriyasannikṛṣṭabhāvakṣaṇānantarakṣaṇe hi jñānaṃ jāyate| tatra tasya bhāvakṣaṇasya svadharmasaṃkramaṇanimittatvaṃ na yujyate| asataḥ kusumādeḥ sphaṭikādiṣu svadhramasaṃkramaṇanimittatvādarśanāt| tathā'pi nīlādisaṃkramaṇābhyupagame tadgataṃ purovartitvanedīyastvadavīyasatvajaḍatvādikamapi saṃkrāmati na vā|
analyzed: tatra idam dūṣaṇam indriya sannikṛṣṭa bhāva kṣaṇa anantara kṣaṇe hi jñānam jāyate tatra tasya bhāva kṣaṇasya sva dharma saṃkramaṇa nimitta tvam na yujyate asataḥ kusuma ādeḥ sphaṭika ādiṣu sva dhrama saṃkramaṇa nimitta tva adarśanāt tathā api nīla ādi saṃkramaṇa abhyupagame tad gatam purovarti tva nedīyaḥ tva davīyas tva jaḍa tva ādikam api saṃkrāmati na vā anya tva anya tva anya tva anya tva anya tva anya tva anya tva anya tva anya tva anya

original: "so'śnute sarvānkāmānsaha brahmaṇa vipaścite"ti tanmātraśravaṇaliṅgāt| evaṃ brahmāsādhāraṇaṃ jagavdyāpāraṃ muktāssatyasaṃkalpā api kathamāśaseran| te ca teṣāṃ satyasaṃkalpatvādiguṇāśca muktāvapi bhagavatparatantrā iti hi "tasya ca nityatvā"diti dvitīyādhyāyasūtreṇa pratipāditam|

original: muktānāṃ satyasaṃkalpatā'pi bhagavatparicaraṇopayogisvadehapitrādyupakaraṇasṛṣṭimātraviṣayeti sarveśvarasya bhagavataḥ puruṣottamasyaiva jagatsṛṣṭyādivyāpāraḥ||
analyzed: muktānām satya saṃkalpa tā api bhagavat paricaraṇa upayogi sva deha pitṛ ādi upakaraṇa sṛṣṭi mātra viṣayā iti sarva īśvarasya bhagavataḥ puruṣottamasya eva jagat sṛṣṭi ādi vyāpāraḥ

original: saṃgrahakārikāḥ||
analyzed: saṃgraha kārikāḥ

original: aiśvaryaṃ muktibhājāmapinikhilajagavdyāpṛtivyāpakaṃ syādāmrātā brahmaṇā yatparamasaddaśatā satyasaṃkalpatā ca|
analyzed: aiśvaryam mukti bhājām api nikhila jagat dyāpṛti vyāpakam syāt āmrātā brahmaṇā yat parama sat daśa tā satya saṃkalpa tā ca

original: kāmānnīkārūpī sakalabhunasañcāraśālī svarāḍityādiṣṭe yattatopi sphuṭamiha cagatāntādadhīnyapratītiḥ||
analyzed: sakala bhuna sañcāra śālī svarāj iti ādiṣṭe yat tatas api sphuṭam iha ca gata antāt adhīnya pratītiḥ

original: maivaṃ brahmaprakaraṇagatāssṛṣṭisaṃhāramukhyāḥ
analyzed: mā evam brahma prakaraṇa gatāḥ sṛṣṭi saṃhāra mukhyāḥ

original: sambadhyante kathamapi na taissannidhānaprasaṅge|
analyzed: sambadhyante katham api na taiḥ sannidhāna prasaṅge

original: tattallokaprathitaviṣayābhogabhogaikabhāvaṃ
analyzed: tad tad loka prathita viṣaya ābhoga bhoga eka bhāvam

original: naivācaṣṭe niyamapitṛtāṃ lokasañcārasūktiḥ||
analyzed: na eva ācaṣṭe niyama pitṛtām loka sañcāra su uktiḥ

original: heyāapi muktānāṃ vikāralokasthitā bhṛśaṃ bhogāḥ|
analyzed: heyāḥ api muktānām vikāra loka sthitāḥ bhṛśam bhogāḥ

original: brahmavibhūtitayā syurbhogyāssavibhūtikaṃ tadanubhavati||
analyzed: brahma vibhūti tayā syuḥ bhogyāḥ sa vibhūtikam tat anubhavati

original: muktānāṃ yā satyasaṃkalpatoktā tatsaṃkalpādhīnasattaiva sā'pi|
analyzed: muktānām yā satya saṃkalpa tā uktā tad saṃkalpa adhīna sattā eva sā api

original: tecānye ye tadguṇāssarva ete'pyāpadyante sarvadā tādadhīnyam||
analyzed: te ca anye ye tad guṇāḥ sarve ete api āpadyante sarvadā tādadhīnyam

original: evaṃ muktāvapyacidvastu tulyaṃ jīvāssarve śeṣataikasvabhāvāḥ|
analyzed: evam muktau api acit vastu tulyam jīvāḥ sarve śeṣa tā eka svabhāvāḥ

original: iti jagavdyāpāravarjādhikaraṇam||6||
analyzed: iti jagat dyāpāra varja adhikaraṇam

original: iti śrīmadbhāradvajākulajaladhikaustubha śrīmadadvaitavidyācārya śrīviśvajidyājiśrīraṅgarājādhvarivarasūnorappayadīkṣitasya kṛtau caturmatasāre nayamayūkhamālikākhye dvitīyaparicchede caturthasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat bhāradvaja ākula jaladhi kaustubha śrīmat advaitavidya ācārya śrī viśvajit yāji śrī raṅga rāja adhvari vara sūnoḥ appaya dīkṣitasya kṛtau caturmatasāre nayamayūkhamālikā ākhye dvitīya paricchede caturthasya adhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ

original: iti hayavadanaparabrahmaṇe namaḥ||

original: ||adhyāyaśca samāptaḥ||
